question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组小组赛：加拿大 vs 卡塔尔（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Canada vs Qatar (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 加拿大坐镇温哥华主场、Elo 优势近 470 分，尽管伤病困扰仍是大概率取胜一方；卡塔尔状态低迷，爆冷空间有限。
one_liner_en: Hosting in Vancouver with a near-470-point Elo edge, Canada are heavy favourites despite injury concerns; out-of-form Qatar have limited upset room.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：加拿大 1788（世界第 25）+100 主场加成 vs 卡塔尔 1421（世界第 96），统计基线给加拿大约 80% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Canada 1788 (world #25) plus a +100 host bonus vs Qatar 1421 (world #96); the statistical baseline gives Canada about 80%.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大伤病疑云：Davies（腿筋）缺席首战、6/18 出场存疑，主力中卫 Bombito 据报离队，David 状态平平——小幅下调加拿大胜率。
key_reasons.en: Canadian injury cloud: Davies (hamstring) misses the opener and is doubtful for June 18, starting CB Bombito reportedly off the roster, David below form - a small trim to Canada's win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔在 Lopetegui 治下 2025 夏以来仅 2 胜、世预赛勉强过关，自身状态不足以支撑更大的爆冷调整。
key_reasons.en: Qatar have only 2 wins under Lopetegui since summer 2025 and scraped through qualifying - their own form does not support a larger upset adjustment.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for Canada group match) -> p_stat 0.800/0.146/0.054; bounded evidence adjustment (Canada -3pp, draw +2pp, Qatar +1pp, within the +/-8pp cap) -> p_final. No betting or prediction-market data used.
